End-to-end proof harness for the 2026-09-16 fleet-ledger overflow failure: it is read-only against `scripts/fleet-dispatcher.mjs` and writes only under incident fixtures plus the optional `--report` path. anchors.note_text: Field note for the `lean-cargo` fleet mission, titled "lean-cargo — kill the cargo lock convoy" (`scripts/lean-cargo/README.md:1`); it states the problem as a machine-wide `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/scratch/tmp/vgpnk/cargo-target` export that collapses every lane onto one `.cargo-lock`, so concurrent `cargo build|test|check` serialize. The "What ships" section claims `bin/cargo-shim.sh` is installed at `~/.cargo/bin/cargo`, replacing the rustup proxy symlink (backup `cargo.rustup-proxy`, uninstall = move it back) and ending in `exec -a cargo rustup` so toolchain resolution stays byte-identical to stock (`scripts/lean-cargo/README.md:11-13`). Its per-subcommand table assigns raw arg passthrough to the net-mutating/meta class, the `--frozen` plus private target slot treatment (`flock` on `cargo-slots/s<N>.lock`, 32 slots, acquired warmest-first by `.lean-use` stamp, up to 8 read-only overlay lowers) to the build family, and env-only treatment to query verbs; `LEAN_CARGO_DISABLE=1` is documented as the byte-for-byte stock baseline (`scripts/lean-cargo/README.md:28`). The measured table claims a 2× concurrent convoy at 30.8 s / 28.9 s with 7–8 lock-wait lines against slots at 36.8 s with zero waits, and a 0.93% sccache hit rate in the pre-overlay era. The Files section claims `measure.sh` wipes sccache when given `RESET_CACHE=1` (`scripts/lean-cargo/README.md:72`) — that variable exists nowhere in the script, whose `rm -rf "$SCCACHE_DIR"` wipe is unconditional (`scripts/lean-cargo/measure.sh:66`) — and the Installed-system-state section pins `pacman -S sccache` → 0.17.0 plus the installed shim's byte-identity to `bin/cargo-shim.sh` (`scripts/lean-cargo/README.md:77-78`). re-anchored at 31c465f1 (round 35)

The drop-in `cargo` replacement installed at `~/.cargo/bin/cargo`; every path ends in `raw() { exec -a cargo "$RUSTUP_BIN" "$@"; }` (`scripts/lean-cargo/bin/cargo-shim.sh:36`) so toolchain resolution stays byte-identical to the stock rustup proxy. `LEAN_CARGO_DISABLE=1` is the measurement baseline — byte-for-byte stock behavior (`:27`) — and the fleet layout is three env-overridable roots: `CONVOY` (`:47`), `SLOT_ROOT`, and `NSLOTS` defaulting to 32 (`:49`). Subcommand dispatch is a `case` on the located `sub`; the build family is the literal `BUILD_FAMILY="build|test|check|clippy|run|bench|doc|rustc"` (`:117`) and takes a private overlayfs slot, while `metadata`/`fetch`/`tree`/`pkgid`/`verify-project` deliberately take the env-only path. `have` (`:125`) is the argv-contains helper and `lean_frozen_cache_digest` (`:128`) gates the `--frozen`/offline preflight, so a workspace that needs the network is never frozen. Idle slots past `LEAN_CARGO_SLOT_MAX_AGE_MIN` (default 720 min) are reaped (`:210`), and fresh top-level executables publish back to the convoy bin pool even when `rc != 0` (`:312`).

anchors.note_text: Idempotent installer that puts the lean-cargo shim at `~/.cargo/bin/cargo`, backing up the rustup-proxy symlink once as `cargo.rustup-proxy`. It resolves its own tracked source from `SCRIPT_SOURCE` (`scripts/lean-cargo/install-shim.sh:9`) and takes its `cargo-shim.sh` payload from `SHIM_SRC` (`:20`), refusing with exit 2 when that source is unresolvable or `HOME` is unset. `CARGO_BIN` (`:25`) is the install target and `BACKUP` (`:26`) the one-shot symlink backup path. When the target already equals the shim (`cmp -s`, `:35`) it prints `already installed` and exits 0; a pre-existing non-symlink `REAL_BACKUP` is refused by name (`:49`) instead of being clobbered. The copy is atomic — `install -m 0755` to a `.tmp.$$` path then `mv -f` (`:62`) under an EXIT trap that removes the temp file.

Convoy-vs-slots measurement harness, run as `bash scripts/lean-cargo/measure.sh [outdir]` (usage at `scripts/lean-cargo/measure.sh:3`); it resolves `ROOT` from `readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"` and `cd`s there, exiting 2 if that fails (`:7`). It runs under `set -uo pipefail` — deliberately without errexit — and writes `<outdir>/measure-<ts>/` with `summary.txt` plus raw per-invocation logs, defaulting the outdir to `$ROOT/.ufo/scopes/lean-cargo`. Phase A measures the baseline convoy with `LEAN_CARGO_DISABLE=1` and `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$CONVOY"`, two background `one_build` followers; phase B primes sccache and then runs two shimmed concurrent builds; phase C measures one cold-slot build under `LEAN_CARGO_SLOT_ROOT=/scratch/tmp/vgpnk/cargo-slots-cold` (`:84`). The load is `BUILD=(cargo test -p ufo-core-runtime -p ufo-cli --verbose)` (`:16`) — `--verbose` is deliberate so the shim skips its `-q` injection and lock-wait lines stay visible — and contention is counted by `lock_waits()` grepping `Blocking waiting for file lock` (`:43`). Any phase build failure routes through `die` → stderr plus exit 2, and the closing evidence block diffs `sccache --show-stats` before/after and `du -sh` the convoy, slot root and `$SCCACHE_DIR` (`:95`); the sccache wipe before phase B is unconditional (`:66`), which is why the README's documented reset flag does not match this file.

Phase A measures the baseline convoy with `LEAN_CARGO_DISABLE=1` and `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$CONVOY"`, two background `one_build` followers; phase B primes sccache and then runs two shimmed concurrent builds; phase C measures one cold-slot build under `LEAN_CARGO_SLOT_ROOT=/scratch/tmp/vgpnk/cargo-slots-cold` (`:84`). The load is `BUILD=(cargo test -p ufo-core-runtime -p ufo-cli --verbose)` (`:16`) — `--verbose` is deliberate so the shim skips its `-q` injection and lock-wait lines stay visible — and contention is counted by `lock_waits()` grepping `Blocking waiting for file lock` (`:43`). Any phase build failure routes through `die` → stderr plus exit 2, and the closing evidence block diffs `sccache --show-stats` before/after and `du -sh` the convoy, slot root and `$SCCACHE_DIR` (`:95`); the sccache wipe before phase B is unconditional (`:66`), which is why the README's documented reset flag does not match this file.

The single-shot CLI is `main` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:316`) over a loopback chat-completions backend, invoked as dedupe, digest or classify and printing one JSON document whose schema is `ufo-local-helper-v1` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:342`). The endpoint comes from `UFO_LOCAL_HELPER_URL` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:325`) and defaults to `DEFAULT_URL` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:8`) `http://127.0.0.1:34113`; anything but a credential-free loopback HTTP URL is refused as `endpoint_invalid` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:161`), and that check runs before stdin is read (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:325-327`). Input is bounded by `MAX_INPUT_BYTES` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:10`) inside `readInput` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:135`): an oversized stream dies `input_too_large` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:128`), empty input dies `input_invalid` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:131`), and invalid UTF-8 dies at `:142`. Model output is re-validated rather than trusted — `validateDedupe` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:259`), `validateDigest` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:292`) and `validateClassification` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:300`) raise `model_output_invalid` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:302`) — so a hallucinated index or label refuses instead of passing through. Every refusal is a `HelperError` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:17`) with a stable snake_case type, emitted on stderr as `ufo-local-helper-error-v1` (`scripts/local-helper.mjs:356`) with exit code 2 (`process.exitCode = 2`, `:359`).

Per-launch OMP extension loaded only through `omp --extension <absolute path>` on the interactive Main seat of `scripts/run-omp-native-trial.mjs`, and deliberately kept outside `.omp/hooks` and `.omp/config.yml` so discovery never auto-loads it into an L0 or an L2 worker session. Its exported surface is `MAX_STOP_BLOCKS` = 4 (`scripts/omp-native-shutdown.mjs:35`), `HONEST_STATUSES` = {`completed`, `degraded`, `blocked_after_full_topology`} (`:36`) and `evaluateMainArtifact` (`:51`), which opens the final Main artifact once with `O_NOFOLLOW` and `O_NONBLOCK` under a 1 MiB `MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES` bound (`:37`) and accepts it only when `run_id` matches the launch, `l1` is `Main`, `judge` is `ufo` and the status is honest. The `session_stop` hook blocks the stop with `decision: "block"` while the artifact is premature or mismatched, and once `state.blocks >= MAX_STOP_BLOCKS` it allows the stop and lets the settled turn release the pane so the collector rejects the run honestly instead of the composer idling forever (`:222`). Release requires both an armed `session_stop` and a terminal `agent_end` — `willContinue === true` (the omp 18.2.6 spelling) defers, and a runtime without `ctx.shutdown` records `release_unsupported` rather than throwing. Every decision is persisted to `UFO_NATIVE_GATE_FILE` as `ufo-native-shutdown-v1` through a guarded rewrite that refuses non-regular or multi-linked targets and is best-effort, so a gate-write failure can never wedge the session.

**Owning surface** — `roleWork` (`scripts/omp-role-work.mjs:213`) renders the natural-language duty block a launcher embeds in one seat assignment; it is a pure template helper owning no envelope, schema or runtime, and writes nothing. The tables are `ROLE_METHODS` (`:38`, ten role postures) and `SCOPE_DUTIES` (`:69`, 16 frozen `"role:scope"` duties), plus `SHARED_BOUNDS` (`:121`) and per-role `ROLE_EXTRA_BOUNDS` (`:129`). Import-time guards throw `RoleWorkError` (`:23`) on malformed duty keys, non-function duties or non-string bounds arrays, so the module fails at load rather than mid-launch. Seat identity comes from `seatId` (`:21`) in `ufo-native-names.mjs`, and `evidenceSection` (`:189`) renders the evidence schema and points to `<runDir>/evidence/<seatLabel>.json` with scratch under `<runDir>/scratch/`.

"devin-native-v1": {
   "transport": "devin/subagent",
   "judge": "crates/ufo-core-runtime",
   "evidenceKind": "in_session_subagent_dispatch",
   "admittedByJudgeHandoff": false,
   "honestyNote": "Devin run_subagent seats produce session-local dispatch evidence, not an omp-native-v1 transcript handoff; `ufo judge-handoff` admits the omp-native profiles only (frozen `omp-native-v1`, strict `omp-native-v2`, and `omp-native-resilient-v1` on an operator re-charter). The judged path on this substrate stays `self-iter` delegation to the canonical Rust runtime.",
   "seatProfiles": ".devin/agents/ufo-<role>.md",
   "headlessArgv": [
    "devin",
    "-p",
    "--permission-mode",
    "dangerous",
    "--model",
    "<modelId>",
    "--",
    "<assignment>"
   ],
   "concurrencyCeiling": 16,
   "planner": {
    "role": "planner",
    "depth": 1,
    "count": 1
   },
   "proposalRoles": [
    "scout",
    "reviewer",
    "critic",
    "connector",
    "sentinel",
    "executor",
    "mutation-tester",
    "revenger",
    "simplifier",
    "scribe"
   ],
   "distiller": {
    "role": "distiller",
    "depth": 1,
    "count": 1
   },
   "probe": {
    "role": "labrat",
    "depth": 2,
    "parent": "executor",
    "count": 1,
    "readOnly": true,
    "parentMaxNesting": 2
   },
   "contractProvenance": "seat topology only: roles and depths are project-owned; every seat route, fallback, and model catalog is owned by the global OMP config"
  }

anchors.note_text: Library-only routing mirror builder: this module deliberately has no CLI (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:14-16`). `MIRROR_PATH` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:41`) names `crates/ufo-core-runtime/bundled/omp-seat-routing.json`; `MIRROR_SCHEMA` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:42`) is `ufo-seat-routing-v1`. `renderSeatRoutingMirror` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:253`) serializes the result of `buildSeatRoutingMirror` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:211`) but does not publish it; `sync-ufo-contracts.mjs` owns the write through `writeFileAtomic` (`scripts/sync-ufo-contracts.mjs:635`). The seat vocabulary is `CORE_SEATS` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:53`, module-local), `PROPOSAL_SEATS` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:54`, module-local) and exported `MIRROR_SEATS` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:66`); `RESOLVER_VERSION` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:48`) is module-local. Effort parsing and the whitelist live in `parseRoute` (`scripts/omp-route-grammar.mjs:88`; check at `scripts/omp-route-grammar.mjs:104-108`), while `validateChain` starts at `scripts/omp-route-grammar.mjs:139`. The banned-gemini screen is `assertAdmissibleRoute` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:89-95`); it lowercases routes before allowing the `google-antigravity/` prefix, and rejects other gemini-family routes as malformed. Group safety flows through `routingGroupProblem` in `omp-route-grammar.mjs` (`scripts/omp-route-grammar.mjs:194`) called from `chainGroup` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:105-109`); groups remain opaque. The snapshot option is passed into `buildSeatRoutingMirror` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:209-214`), and serialization helpers are `canonicalJson` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:120`) and `canonicalJsonCompact` (`scripts/sync-global-routing.mjs:129`). Its inline argv guard admits only those two flags (`:32-37`); a foreign argument writes to stderr and exits 64 (`:32-36`). `UFO_PROJECTION_ROOT` selects `projectionRoot` and `projectionOnly` (`:44-47`); there is no `--check-committed` mode. The module composes `readPolicy` (`:16`), `writeFileAtomic` (`:19`) and `validateTickMachineConfig` (`:18`); `fixtureLaneRoles` is module-local at `:1225`, not exported. The report prints at `:2136`, then `!report.ok` sets exit 1 at `:2137`. The shared credential-shape screen used by both the native-trial launcher and the handoff collector, deliberately byte-exact to the judge's `detail_contains_credential` mirror. `containsCredentialShape` (`scripts/ufo-credential-screen.mjs:18`) applies an ASCII-only fold and matches three literal needles in `SECRET_LITERAL_NEEDLES` (`:14`) plus provider token prefixes in `SECRET_TOKEN_NEEDLES` (`:15`) only when at least `SECRET_TOKEN_MIN = 12` token characters follow (`:16`) — so `sk-42` never trips. The evidence-writing side is wider: `containsSensitiveShape` (`:62`) adds `SENSITIVE_LITERAL_RE` (`:51`, catching the compact `eyJ…` JWT shape and `PRIVATE KEY`) and re-scans text stripped by `FORMAT_CHARS_RE` (`:61`, applied at `:65-68`), because invisible Cf/Mn/Zs characters split a shape without changing what a reader copies out. The widening lives only on this side — stripping in the judge mirror would break parity, so callers layer their own shapes on top rather than editing the needle sets. A value either side would redact must never reach `launch.json`, `rejection.txt`, `handoff.json` or an `effectiveLaunch` host field.

The evidence-writing side is wider: `containsSensitiveShape` (`:62`) adds `SENSITIVE_LITERAL_RE` (`:51`, catching the compact `eyJ…` JWT shape and `PRIVATE KEY`) and re-scans text stripped by `FORMAT_CHARS_RE` (`:61`, applied at `:65-68`), because invisible Cf/Mn/Zs characters split a shape without changing what a reader copies out. The widening lives only on this side — stripping in the judge mirror would break parity, so callers layer their own shapes on top rather than editing the needle sets. Pure projection of mission activity for UFO wall panes: `projectMissionActivity` (`scripts/ufo-mission-activity.mjs:123`) validates the closed input `{mission, task, activity}`, delegates lifecycle to `projectMissionLifecycle`, and returns the schema-tagged view `ACTIVITY_SCHEMA` (`:14`) with bounded `activity` and `label`. Bounds are Unicode code points, never UTF-16 units: `ACTIVITY_MAX_CODE_POINTS` is 240 (`:17`). `sanitizeDisplayText` strips C0/C1, ANSI/OSC, bidi controls and tmux format tokens, failing `INVALID_ACTIVITY` for a non-string (`:57`), before anything is bounded. `renderMissionActivity` (`:150`) is the single-line renderer and refuses a view whose schema is not `ACTIVITY_SCHEMA` with `INVALID_VIEW` (`:152`). The CLI takes `[json|text] [file|-]`; `main` is at `scripts/ufo-mission-activity.mjs:210`, and only direct invocation (`isMainModule`, `:226`) runs it. Refusals emit a `ufo-mission-activity-error-v1` envelope and exit 1.

The CLI is inspection-only (`:85-103`), gated by `isMainModule` (`:90`), and accepts `--help` or one optional file/`-` operand; invalid extra or flag-like operands throw `TypeError` (`:99-100`). Refusal-aware blocked-row repend duty extracted from `ufo-night-watchdog.sh`, exported as `main` (`scripts/ufo-watchdog-repend.mjs:366`) and run through `isMainModule(import.meta.url)` → `process.exitCode = main()` (`:426-427`). Its argv surface is `--queue`/`--state`/`--fleet`/`--dispatcher`/`--quiet-seconds`/`--min-age-seconds`/`--now`; any other token is an `unsupported argument` fault (`:360`), printed to stderr with exit 64 (`:366-371`). Eligibility is queue state `blocked` and age over `DEFAULT_MIN_AGE_SECONDS` (240), plus matching fleet membership when `--fleet` is supplied (`:278-280`). A successful repend consumes one of `MAX_ATTEMPTS` = 3 (`:58`) while refusal or failure does not. The durable state file is `STATE_SCHEMA` = 2 (`:57`) with legacy bare `{key: n}` reads as attempts; it now also carries a `notes` dedupe member, and attempts/refusals/notes for rows no longer blocked are pruned (`:341-345`). `STABLE_REFUSAL_REASONS` = {`mission_stale_registered`} (`:64`) is quieted for `DEFAULT_QUIET_SECONDS` (900) only while `rowSignature(row)` and the manifest class remain unchanged (`:244-249`, `:282`); transient refusal classes are never suppressed (`:244-249`). This r07 stable-refusal suppression covers a dispatcher refusal of `mission_stale_registered`, which is designed not to succeed on retry. Child stdout/stderr tails are redacted and capped by `SPAWN_FAILURE_TAIL_MAX` = 120 (`:159`); an unreadable queue prints one stamped line and returns 0. re-anchored at 31c465f1 (round 35)
